Orders page, round 20: L2 Order Ledger, exact FileMaker positions (proposed, for client approval)

The client’s feedback on L1: “The main reason for the redesign is so that our design resembles the client’s current software, ensuring the client doesn’t have to learn our software from scratch. Whatever is in a particular position must remain in that exact position.” L2 rebuilds each order from the positions of the client’s FileMaker Online Orders Ledger: every field and button sits where it sits in FileMaker (measured in points from the client’s screenshot), in the client’s colours, with L1’s text size and spacing. FulfilPro’s extra features take the places of the controls the client no longer needs, or sit in free space beside related controls; the table under the artboards lists every object. Artboards are 1512 × 982 (MacBook Pro 14″, sidebar collapsed) and interactive. L1 (round 19) and the current app (A1) follow for comparison.

L2
L2 · Order Ledger, exact FileMaker positionsProposed · for client approval · 1512 × 982
Answers the client’s feedback on L1: “Whatever is in a particular position must remain in that exact position.” Every object of the client’s order block (header line, line header, lines, footer) is drawn at the x position measured from their screenshot, as a share of the order width, so it lines up with what the staff see in FileMaker today. Text size, spacing and colours are L1’s. FulfilPro’s extras take the slots of the controls the client said they no longer need, or sit in free space next to related controls; the table under the artboards lists every object.
Same positions as FileMakerSame text size and spacing as L1Needs the same new data fields as L1

Same position as FileMaker · every object of the client’s order block

x = left edge in FileMaker points, measured from the client’s screenshot (block width 1494 pt). L2 draws each object at x / 1494 of the order width, so the layout lines up with the client’s screen; text size and spacing are L1’s. Roles hide what they cannot use and leave the gap, as FileMaker privileges do. Colours, the data the build round needs and the open questions are the same as L1 (notes under the L1 artboards).

Round 19: L1 Order Ledger (first version)

The Orders page redesigned around the client’s FileMaker Online Orders Ledger: the same three bands per order (header line, lines, footer panel), the client’s own colours (measured from their screenshots, so the staff read the page the way they read FileMaker today), and every FulfilPro feature kept inside those bands. Each of the client’s 18 numbered controls is mapped below the artboards (kept, merged, removed or new), followed by the colour legend, the role split, the data the build round needs and the open questions. Artboards are 1440 × 900 (sidebar collapsed) and are interactive: expand / collapse, omit, select the found set, Urgent, Production, Pick & Pack, the design steps, Marketing, the Sync ••• popover and Delete all respond. The current app (A1) stays further down for comparison.

L1
L1 · Order Ledger: the client’s FileMaker layout and colours, with every FulfilPro featureProposed · for client approval · 1440 × 900
Built from the 13 Nov walkthrough of the client’s “Order Scheduler · Online Orders Ledger”. Each order keeps the client’s three bands: a header line (date, order, branch, name, email, ship to, PO, tracking, label and tax invoice with their P printed state) coloured with the client’s own legend, the lines (description, SKU, size, qty, price, shipped / refunded, stock, supplier · PO, packed, tracking, status, stock return, back order, remark), and a footer panel (Production and Pick & Pack lights, Urgent and Repeat, Picking list | P, totals, payment with the star, Design sent › approved › colours, Marketing + VIP). FulfilPro’s extras sit in the same bands. Collapsed, an order is one coloured line, as in FileMaker.

Order colours · the client’s legend, where each one shows

ColourHexWhereRule in FulfilPro
Red · Late#f4c4c4Header lineSlip printed over 24 h ago and not packed / not shipped (today’s Late Unpacked, Shipped Delayed), or past the Urgent need-by date
Green · Paid#b8e874Header lineFully paid and not shipped yet
Light · Shipped#dcf0f8Header, line, footerFulfilled (whole order, or that line)
Dark · Shipped a part#b3d1ef to confirmHeader, line, footerPartially fulfilled
Purple · Purchased#e4ccfcLineA purchase order exists for the line
Peach · To pick#f8e0a0 to confirmFooterPicking list printed, not fully packed (seen in the video, not in the legend)
None · New#ffffffHeader, line, footerNo PO, not shipped, not paid
Grey · Canceled / closed#eceaf2 proposalHeader lineNew: red already means Late, so canceled orders are grey with the number struck through
Payment starPaid (clear)UnpaidPartly paidShipped, money owing
Left borderEvery order has a 4px left border in its header-line status, in a stronger shade so it reads at a glance when collapsed: red Late, green Paid, sky Shipped, dark blue Shipped a part, grey New, muted grey Canceled / closed.
LightsProduction: pale, then green when the order has decoration (with the room date). Pick & Pack: orange until packed, then green. Picking list / Label / Tax invoice: the P fills in once printed.
PaletteMeasured from the client’s screenshots: brand purple #5c44d8, deep purple #482ca0, lavender #8c74f4, plum #6c1498, orchid #cc7cf4, magenta #9c20e4, lime #b8e874, light blue #dcf0f8, shipped cell #3474a0, green #64c878, teal #74d8c4, orange #ec9c3c, yellow #f4d458, title grey #c0c0c0. Text-bearing blue (Label) is deepened to #3a78c2 so white text stays readable.

The client’s numbered controls (client-old-system-marking.png) → this design

#Old systemDecisionIn the Ledger
0(−) at the start of the orderNewOmit: hides the order from the current found set only (Undo toast). Nothing is deleted
1Tick above “Online Order”MergedThe checkbox in the column-title row selects the whole found set (not just the page) for the bulk bar
2Order tick (lines)MergedNo separate icon: the tick in the line header ticks every line (Full)
3Eye + magnifier next to the nameKept / removedEye opens our Customer record; the magnifier is removed
4Task / ProblemRemovedFulfilPro already has Tasks
4·5Label | P, Tax invoice | PMergedOur label and tax-invoice print. The P segment fills with the button colour once printed
6Delete (bin)NewAdmin only. Deletes the order from FulfilPro, never from Shopify, after a confirm dialog
7Take fromRemovedNot used
8ProductionNewLights green automatically on embroidery / setup fee / printing / decoration. Click: date + time it went to the decoration room (shown on the light)
9Pick to do date, (Paid) payment follow-upRemoved / movedPick-to-do date removed (summary). The payment follow-up date shows in the payment box when money is owing
10Pick & PackMergedOrange until picked and packed, then green with the date. It is our Confirm packed (Full / Partial per line, notify)
11UrgentNewToggle + date the customer needs the goods; urgent orders go to the top of every list. Repeat order added next to it
12SupplierRemovedNot used; supplier and PO live on each line
13StarNewPayment state, in the client’s colours (below)
14·16Design sent › Design approved › Colours chosen + name fieldNewThree steps, each goes green when done; the field shows the clicked step’s value (designer, who approved, thread numbers). Customer design upload next to it
15A4 / Label (orange), Booking Ship, Emb / Print dateRemoved / movedThe old courier service is gone. The decoration-room date is on the Production light (#8)
17Marketing: All, One month, Three / Six months, Anniversary, Edit, HistoryNewAll ticked on a new order. VIP added (manual). Edit opens the marketing layout
18≡ master select (On time)MergedThe tick in the line header selects every line (Full)
—Order’s remarkMergedOur Order notes (note icon with count in the header line)
—Stock return, Back order, Remark per lineNewPer line: return, back-order quantity and a free-text remark (e.g. “used 1105 from stock”)
—Sync now ••• (date range, stores, new only, sync cycle)NewPopover on our Sync button
—Quick buttons (Urgent, To-do today, Pick & Pack, Production, Back order, Stock return, Stock out, No PO)NewQuick-filter row, plus Repeat and VIP; the colour legend sits at its right
—Total paid + payment-method totals, Daily reportNewPurple bottom bar (Admin, Staff)

Kept from FulfilPro (not in the old system)

  • Search with field picker and barcode
  • Store, Period, Status, Packed, Print filters, queue tabs, sort
  • Approvals strip
  • Per line: Avail, PO status / Purchase (+ PO), Decorator (assign, mark done, view), Partial
  • Request stock, Fulfilments history, Confirm fulfilment, & Confirm
  • Stock adjustment (as Stock out), Export names
  • Notes, Messages, 17track, per-order refresh
  • Customer note, Shipping, packing history (info line)
  • Decoration attachments strip (Files, Customer design, Photo, Customer remarks), visible without expanding
  • Bulk bar, pager with rows per page, zoom 50–150%

Who gets the new controls (proposal)

ControlAdminStaffPicker
Omit, expand / collapse, quick filters, colour legend✓✓✓
Urgent / Repeatediteditread
Prices, totals, payment, star, payment-method totalseditread—
Production light + room date, design trackeditreadread (Production)
Pick & Pack (Confirm packed), Picking list | P, slip Remark✓read✓
Label | P, Tax invoice | P✓✓—
Marketing + VIPeditread—
Line remark, Stock return, Back orderediteditread (remark)
Delete order (FulfilPro only)✓——

Data the build round needs (not in FulfilPro today)

  • Order: financial status + outstanding (Shopify displayFinancialStatus, totalOutstandingSet), tags, urgent + need-by date, repeat order, soft delete, tax-invoice printed time, decoration-room date + time, design track (designer, approved by, thread colours), payment follow-up date, payment recorded by staff
  • Customer: marketing preferences (1 / 3 / 6 months, anniversary), VIP; a link from Order to Customer for the eye
  • Order line: remark, stock-return and back-order quantities; supplier / PO link per line
  • Omit: per-user view state (not stored on the order)
  • Sync: date range, new-only, auto-sync period

Questions for the client

  1. What exactly is “Dark = shipped a part” (we used a deeper blue, #b3d1ef), and does the peach footer mean “picking list printed, not picked yet”?
  2. Canceled orders: grey with the order number struck through, since red already means Late?
  3. Is it fine to drop the Pick to do date, keeping the payment follow-up date (shown when money is owing)?
  4. What makes an order Late? Proposed: slip printed over 24 h ago and not packed / not shipped, or past the urgent need-by date.
  5. Should Staff be able to change Marketing and VIP, or only Admin?
  6. Should the header turn Paid green from Shopify’s payment status, or only when your team records the payment?
  7. Do you still need the line Due date and Purchase status columns, or is the PO status with its ETA (in Supplier · PO) enough?

Current app: Concept A1 (for comparison)

The chosen way to merge the Orders page and the Picking List into one compact page (the other six concepts are retired). It is shown for the three roles that reach it today, so you can see exactly what each person gets and what stays hidden. Every order line now also shows the product colour, a Shopify admin link and, for Admin and Staff, the available quantity and purchase order status; Admin gets a + PO button on short lines. The layout is built on these ideas: queue tabs with live counts, one smart search, filters as chips, a stage track per order, today’s filters (Store, Period, Status, Packed, Print) and a green printer icon once the picking slip is printed, one bulk bar, and the zoom control from Inventory (50–150%, Ctrl +/−/0; try it on any screen). Artboards are 1280 × 800 and need no page scroll; the order list scrolls inside its card, with two orders opened on every role.

Concept A1 is the queue table re-laid so the queue and an opened order fit 1280 px without sideways scroll (the original, wider A1 and concepts B–F are no longer published).

All orders, customers and numbers on these screens are synthetic samples. Round 3 added what the first rounds left out (request stock, decoration, attachments, name export, fulfilment depth, picking-slip and notify dialogs): see dialogs.html for the dialogs and menus and PARITY.md for the full old-vs-new checklist.

Who sees what
Slip printed: Admin, Staff (read-only). Label, delivery, restock, decoration: Admin and Staff. Packed date replaces Status for Order Picker. Shipped (Shopify status) uses the same blue chip as Fulfilled.

Questions from the earlier rounds (A1)

  • Should barcode search open up to Staff? Today only the Picking List has it.
  • Is a separate “Picked” stage needed? Today “picked” is implied by printing the slip.
  • Filters are now exactly today’s, including Late Unpacked / Shipped Delayed in the Packed menu. Keep them, or retire the 24 h late rule?
  • Is “Print packing slip” the picking slip (Picking List) or the shipping label (Orders)? The green icon is built for the picking slip.
  • Request stock (free-text supplier) and Purchase Orders overlap. Keep both for now, or move Request stock onto POs later?
  • Route name: keep /orders for everyone, or introduce a new route and redirect both old pages?
  • Should pickers see a simple “short, on PO” hint? Today pickers have no access to Inventory, so it is left out.
  • Should the + PO button prefill the shortfall (shown) or the supplier’s usual reorder quantity?
  • Should the product link also offer the storefront page, or is Shopify admin enough?
  • Pickers keep their current home page behaviour (they land on this page, not on a separate list).
